recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If future work wants to modernize remaining ICD-11 history prose, handle it as a THO/UTG content update rather than recreating an ICD usage page in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-22996 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary change request for the FHIR-core "Using ICD-[X] Codes with FHIR" page. It asked to remove the obsolete sentence saying, "The next revision, ICD-11, is scheduled for release in 2017."
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in 9500b398d1d850a06cd180c82ce330e4809a2b49, a Vocabulary R5 batch commit whose message lists FHIR-22996 and whose patch removed the exact obsolete sentence from source/icd.html.
additional_context: FHIR-31601 raised the same stale sentence and later added an updated ICD-11 release/history sentence before FHIR-35933 moved external-code-system usage pages, including the ICD page, out of FHIR core and into THO. Current core source includes source/terminologies-systems.html in the page hierarchy, identifies THO as authoritative for external terminology guidance, and links ICD usage to https://terminology.hl7.org/ICD.html. FHIR-31601 is already represented on the combined branch by 62250a8dd4cd10a4d85da6e5eba17edccd8329a7.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source edit is needed because source/icd.html is intentionally absent, the current core terminology page already points to THO, and the obsolete 2017 ICD-11 sentence is not present in current core source.
